search.lookup.Definition

This class describe parameters to retrieve data for search lookup.

Available as lseg.data.content.search.lookup.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    view: Views | str,
    terms: str,
    scope: str,
    select: str,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
view Views | str Yes picks a subset of the data universe to search against. see Views
terms str Yes lists the symbols to be solved
scope str Yes identifies the symbology which 'terms' belong to
select str Yes specifies which properties to return for each result doc
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Other parameters can be provided if necessary

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

TypeData instance.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the previously defined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response

Returns

TypeData instance

Example

from lseg.data.content import search
definition = search.lookup.Definition(
    view=search.Views.SEARCH_ALL,
    scope="RIC",
    terms="A,B,NOSUCHRIC,C,D",
    select="BusinessEntity,DocumentTitle"
)
